_comment: Cost per 1,000,000 (1M) tokens in USD. Two value forms: legacy 2-array [input, output], or object {input, output, cached_input, cache_write_5m, cache_write_1h} for models where prompt-cache pricing matters (see forecaster.providers.resolve_price_detail — models without explicit cache fields get provider-default multipliers: claude cached 0.1x/write 1.25x-2x, gpt cached 0.1x, gemini cached 0.25x). One entry per model_id — lookup normalizes provider-prefixed forms like 'openai/gpt-5.4' automatically (see forecaster.providers.resolve_price_per_1m). When swapping a model in pythia/config.yaml llm.models, add its cost entry here; pythia/tests/test_model_registry.py enforces the sync. brave-web-search cost is per-query ($0.005), injected directly in usage dict — zero here to avoid double-counting. Superseded model ids are kept so a rollback via PYTHIA_SPD_ENSEMBLE_SPECS / SIBYL_MODEL still prices correctly. Batch API results are priced at 0.5x by the shared cost helper (usage service_tier=batch), not via entries here. Prices verified 2026-07-27 against provider pricing pages; cached rates for the active fleet verified same date.
